# NEW 2026-11-24 v25.0 Colonization 4.0 (oe_col4_, 0 mainline slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v250_colonization4.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 100% additive engine hooks (zero vanilla overrides, zero mainline slots).

on_took_location_in_peace_treaty = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_col4_on_conquest_transfer
	}
}

on_colonial_charter_finished = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_col4_on_charter_finished
	}
}

on_ending_war = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_col4_on_conquistador_peace
	}
}

on_new_ruler = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_col4_on_colonial_governor
	}
}

yearly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_col4_yearly_maintenance
		oe_col4_yearly_evolution_pulse
	}
}

on_game_started_after_lobby = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_col4_on_start_naming_sync
	}
}

# Global scope on Day 1 post-lobby: immediately apply unified multi-civilization colonial names to pre-existing colonial viceroyalties
oe_col4_on_start_naming_sync = {
	trigger = { current_year >= 1200 }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_col4_start_sync_done } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_col4_start_sync_done value = 1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_col4_named }
				}
				oe_col4_apply_unified_colonial_name = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Root = winner, scope:location = newly taken location
oe_col4_on_conquest_transfer = {
	trigger = { current_year >= 1200 }
	effect = {
		oe_col4_eval_conquest_handover = yes
	}
}

# Root = colonizer finishing a colonial charter; unify names of newly chartered colonial subjects immediately.
oe_col4_on_charter_finished = {
	trigger = { current_year >= 1200 }
	effect = {
		every_subject = {
			limit = {
				oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_col4_named }
			}
			oe_col4_apply_unified_colonial_name = yes
		}
	}
}

# Root = country ending war (check both conquistador itself AND overlord's conquistador subjects)
oe_col4_on_conquistador_peace = {
	trigger = { current_year >= 1200 }
	effect = {
		oe_col4_check_peacetime_conquistador = yes
		every_subject = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = government_reform:conquistador_country
					is_subject_type = conquistador
				}
			}
			oe_col4_check_peacetime_conquistador = yes
		}
	}
}

# Root = country getting a new ruler, scope:new_ruler = character
# Fixes EU5 1.4.9 colonial subjects electing random unaccepted indigenous governors (zero override of republic.txt!).
oe_col4_on_colonial_governor = {
	trigger = { current_year >= 1200 }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes
				exists = overlord
				exists = scope:new_ruler
				scope:new_ruler = {
					NOT = { culture = root.culture }
					NOT = { culture = root.overlord.culture }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = no
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_col4_gov_policy_chosen }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_col4_gov_policy_chosen value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_col4.21 days = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col4_allow_syncretic_gov } }
				scope:new_ruler = {
					change_character_culture = root.overlord.culture
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Lightweight yearly safety net for lingering peacetime conquistadors & unified colonial naming
oe_col4_yearly_maintenance = {
	trigger = {
		current_year >= 1200
		is_rebel_country = no
	}
	effect = {
		oe_col4_check_peacetime_conquistador = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_col4_named }
			}
			oe_col4_apply_unified_colonial_name = yes
		}
	}
}

# v39.0 Late-game Age 5/6 Colonial Awakening pulse (ELR-isolated & 90d-paced)
oe_col4_yearly_evolution_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		oe_main_mod_global_event_allowed = yes
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism }
		oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes
		liberty_desire >= 65
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_col4_evol_ev_cd }
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_col4_awakening_seen }
	}
	effect = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_col4_awakening_seen value = 1 days = 3650 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_col4.206 days = 30 }
	}
}
